title: Installment Schedule by Balance Band, Testing Supplies Payment Plans
content:
**Schedule.** The installments of a Blood Glucose Testing Supply Program payment plan number 2 when the program's balance is below 150.00, 6 when it is at least 150.00 and below 300.00, and the tier's most monthly installments figure when it is at least 300.00. The balance read is the program's whole running balance: remittance patient responsibility, patient charges and refunds less payments and balance adjustments.

| Program's balance | Installments |
|---|---|
| below 150.00 | 2 |
| 150.00 up to but not including 300.00 | 6 |
| 300.00 or more | the tier's most monthly installments figure |

| Tier | Most monthly installments |
|---|---|
| Testing Supplies Self-Pay Program | 0 |
| Testing Supplies Commercial HMO Program | 6 |
| Testing Supplies Commercial PPO Program | 6 |
| Testing Supplies Medicare Advantage Program | 10 |
| Testing Supplies Original Medicare Program | 10 |
| Testing Supplies Medicaid Program | 0 |

**Both sides of each band (hypothetical balances)**

- 149.99 gives 2 installments; 150.00 gives 6.
- 299.99 gives 6; 300.00 gives 10 on the Medicare tiers and 6 on the commercial tiers.
